caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing male figure, rendered in earthy brown and beige tones that reflect the natural grain and texture of the wood. The figure is shown with arms crossed at the waist, one hand touching a long, trailing beard that covers the lower part of the face. The man is dressed in a long, flowing robe with detailed folds and prominent texture, with a belt or sash around the waist. The lower hem of the garment is uneven and appears damaged or unfinished at the ends. The figure has a turban or headdress wrapped around the head, detailed folds suggesting fabric, and the face features a mustache connected to the beard. The background is plain and off-white, allowing full focus on the wooden statue and its intricacies. The overall coloration relies on various shades of brown to suggest depth, shadows, and the carved quality of the object.
title: Circus Wagon Figure: Turk
